title: Using our strapline
slide_intent: Relate a signature and a strapline even when they occupy separate corners. Common scale and alignment let a reader associate the two elements across a page.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can establish a consistent visual relationship between its name and invitation across several layout compositions.
demonstration: A dimensioned logo determines the strapline width from the A in the wordmark to the far edge of the symbol’s face. Four page diagrams compare placements in adjacent corners.
practical_value: Size the supplied strapline artwork from the indicated logo span. Choose its alignment relative to the side where the logo appears.

content_islands.name: Strapline artwork
content_islands.spec: Place the explanation and a labeled specimen in the left text column.

content_islands.name: Size reference
content_islands.spec: Place the logo over a measured strapline at upper right. Mark the shared span with the dimension X.

content_islands.name: Corner diagrams
content_islands.spec: Arrange four page frames in a two-by-two grid. Mark the possible logo and strapline positions with consistent insets and light guidance lines.
